problem: Coding agents need guidance to use Google Stitch, a UI design tool, well. This library of skills teaches agents to design and build with Stitch for developers.

stack.backend: TypeScript tooling; skills need the Stitch MCP server
stack.ai: Agent Skills for Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode, via the Stitch MCP server
stack.deploy: Plugin marketplaces (for example Codex) pulled from the GitHub repo, or manual install

whatsNew: Skills follow the open Agent Skills standard and are grouped into plugins (design, build, utilities) that many different agents can install. They work through the Stitch MCP server.
